text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is so quick to grasp new techniques she starts begging for intensive training regimens every day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon, who has had her eye on Mayano Top Gun, takes this opportunity to work with her in my stead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She conducts her training in such a unique way that it soon leaves Mayano Top Gun dissatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, Hishi Amazon warns her that, despite her good instincts, she's not paying attention to her surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words strike a chord within Mayano Top Gun, who hates losing. She slowly, but surely, begins to get the hang of the training.
